title: Vegan Pinakbet Stuffed Mini Meatballs
description: A fusion of Filipino flavors, this dish combines the savory taste of pinakbet with the convenience of mini meatballs. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: In a food processor, crumble the tofu and mincemeat until well combined.
Add the pinakbet, breadcrumbs, olive oil, salt, and pepper to the processor.
Use a small cookie scoop to form the dough into mini meatballs.
Place the meatballs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the meatballs are lightly browned.
Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
